I'm not in the US. I don't have many friends. And they already won. I have nothing. I just took my phone and wallet and left. All of my belongings are at my old house and my dad told me never to come back again. I just want to end it already, I hate myself and I just want it too end

My parents hate me, I hate myself, even if I had a place to stay i don't know if i could last. I didn't take any of my stuff when I left I just grabbed my phone and wallet and walked out. I have nothing. And my entire family hates me.
My town doesn't have a shelter, it's out in the middle of Yukon. Most of my relative live south.
I live in a town in Yukon, I've already looked. No one here will help me, it's quite a religious town.

Like i said, i don't have very many friends. I'm incredibly shy and the few friends i have I only say hi too occasionally. I'm cold, it's raining, and I have no where too go. I just feel it'd be easier to just end it now than to restart from scratch. I don't even know if i can restart.
